summary: CKGSB's marketing team is in a critical launch phase, with the China Going-Global report and Intelligent China webpage driving immediate action, while resolving an Outlook account lock and refining the knowledge website design.
summaryDetail: The most urgent priority is the China Going-Global report launch: the press release needs Julie's 'for' edit, Ira must send it to IE for distribution, Joseph must review Ira's speech draft for the Sept 15 launch, and Ben must provide the high-resolution backdrop for printing. In parallel, the Intelligent China webpage is set to launch this week to start driving traffic, aligning with the decision to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing while putting US partnerships on hold. The team is also finalizing the knowledge website redesign, having decided to keep the current design but improve menu categorization and integrate videos into topics instead of a separate panel, with Joseph to share his HTML file and meet with Julie for specific feedback. On the operational front, the Outlook account lock issue requires immediate attention: the team must delete and re-login on all devices, check mobile Outlook, contact JSB to confirm the backend unlock, and inspect home devices. Upcoming tasks include Joseph drafting target focus areas, the team analyzing participant profiles, and Xuan providing an update on the two-day Tech in Asia plan, while Julie must share the updated school introduction with Yu Jing for ads and Melvin must send the editable event visual and approve alumni for the luncheon.
